```{r Step 0: Ingest Data, include=TRUE}
analysis_data <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "metrotabledata.csv"))

```

```{r Step 1: Calculate Slope Measure, include=TRUE}
# Option 1: More comprehensive PR filtering
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(!str_detect(NAME, "PR|Puerto Rico|Ponce|San Juan|Mayagüez"))

# Option 2: If you know specific GEOID patterns for PR
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(!str_starts(GEOID, "41"))

# Calculate slope of cost burden over time for each metro area
cb_slope <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2010:2019, 2021:2024)) %>%  # Exclude 2020
  select(GEOID, NAME, year, cost_burdened) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) %>%
  # Only keep metro areas with sufficient data points (at least 10 years)
  filter(n() >= 10) %>%
  # Calculate slope using linear regression
  summarise(
    slope_cb = coef(lm(cost_burdened ~ year))[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(GEOID, slope_cb)

# Join slope back to 2024 data
cbsa_2024_with_slope <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  left_join(cb_slope, by = "GEOID")

# Recreate top10 and bottom10 with slope
top10_with_slope <- cbsa_2024_with_slope %>%
  arrange(desc(agglo_index)) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  select(NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened, slope_cb, med_rent)

bottom10_with_slope <- cbsa_2024_with_slope %>%
  arrange(agglo_index) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  select(NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened, slope_cb, med_rent)

# Update agglo_table with slope
agglo_table_with_slope <- bind_rows(
  top10_with_slope %>% mutate(group = "Top 10"),
  bottom10_with_slope %>% mutate(group = "Bottom 10")
) %>%
  # Keep the original change_cb for comparison if needed
  left_join(
    agglo_table %>% select(NAME, change_cb), 
    by = "NAME"
  )

# View the comparison
agglo_table_with_slope %>%
  mutate(
    slope_cb_percent = slope_cb * 100,  # Convert to percentage points per year
    original_change = scales::percent(change_cb, accuracy = 0.1),
    slope_change = paste0(round(slope_cb_percent, 3), "pp/year")
  ) %>%
  select(group, NAME, original_change, slope_change) %>%
  head(10)

# Create the formatted table with slope
table_data <- agglo_table_with_slope %>%
  mutate(
    agglo_index = round(agglo_index, 2),
    cost_burdened_formatted = scales::percent(cost_burdened, accuracy = 0.1),
    slope_cb_formatted = paste0(round(slope_cb * 100, 3), "pp/yr"),  # Convert to percentage points per year
    med_rent_formatted = scales::dollar(med_rent)
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(group, levels = c("Top 10", "Bottom 10")), desc(agglo_index)) %>%
  select(group, NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened_formatted, slope_cb_formatted, med_rent_formatted, slope_cb)

# Apply conditional coloring to the slope column
table_data$slope_cb_colored <- cell_spec(
  table_data$slope_cb_formatted,
  color = ifelse(table_data$slope_cb < 0, "#2E8B57", "#CD5C5C"),  # Green for negative slope, red for positive
  bold = TRUE
)

# Create the final table
final_table <- table_data %>%
  select(group, NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened_formatted, slope_cb_colored, med_rent_formatted) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Ranking", "Metropolitan Area", "Agglomeration Index", 
                  "Cost Burdened (%)", "Annual Change in Burden", "Median Rent"),
    escape = FALSE,
    format = "html"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  pack_rows("Top 10 Metro Areas", 1, 10, label_row_css = "background-color: #E8F5E8; color: #2E8B57; font-weight: bold;") %>%
  pack_rows("Bottom 10 Metro Areas", 11, 20, label_row_css = "background-color: #FFE8E8; color: #CD5C5C; font-weight: bold;")

final_table
```

```{r Step 2: Create Separate Tables, include=TRUE}
# Create separate datasets for top 10 and bottom 10
top10_data <- agglo_table_with_slope %>%
  filter(group == "Top 10") %>%
  mutate(
    agglo_index = round(agglo_index, 2),
    cost_burdened_formatted = scales::percent(cost_burdened, accuracy = 0.1),
    slope_cb_formatted = paste0(round(slope_cb * 100, 3), "pp/yr"),
    med_rent_formatted = scales::dollar(agglo_index)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(agglo_index))

bottom10_data <- agglo_table_with_slope %>%
  filter(group == "Bottom 10") %>%
  mutate(
    agglo_index = round(agglo_index, 2),
    cost_burdened_formatted = scales::percent(cost_burdened, accuracy = 0.1),
    slope_cb_formatted = paste0(round(slope_cb * 100, 3), "pp/yr"),
    med_rent_formatted = scales::dollar(agglo_index)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(agglo_index))

# Apply conditional coloring for TOP 10 table
top10_data$slope_cb_colored <- cell_spec(
  top10_data$slope_cb_formatted,
  color = ifelse(top10_data$slope_cb < 0, "#2E8B57", "#CD5C5C"),
  bold = TRUE
)

# Create TOP 10 table
top10_table <- top10_data %>%
  select(NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened_formatted, slope_cb_colored, med_rent_formatted) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Metropolitan Area", "Agglomeration Index", 
                  "Cost Burdened (%)", "Annual Change in Burden", "Median Rent"),
    escape = FALSE,
    format = "html",
    caption = "Top 10 Metro Areas by Agglomeration Index"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  )

# Apply conditional coloring for BOTTOM 10 table
bottom10_data$slope_cb_colored <- cell_spec(
  bottom10_data$slope_cb_formatted,
  color = ifelse(bottom10_data$slope_cb < 0, "#2E8B57", "#CD5C5C"),
  bold = TRUE
)

# Create BOTTOM 10 table
bottom10_table <- bottom10_data %>%
  select(NAME, agglo_index, cost_burdened_formatted, slope_cb_colored, med_rent_formatted) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Metropolitan Area", "Agglomeration Index", 
                  "Cost Burdened (%)", "Annual Change in Burden", "Median Rent"),
    escape = FALSE,
    format = "html",
    caption = "Bottom 10 Metro Areas by Agglomeration Index"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  )

# Display both tables
top10_table
bottom10_table

top10_table %>%
  save_kable("toptentable.png")

bottom10_table %>%
  save_kable("bottomten_table.png")
```
